_comment: TEMPLATE (not a prototype): on-chain balance or event (NEAR RPC + independent RPC)
claim: The NEAR mainnet account example.near holds at least 100 NEAR (view_account amount >= 100 * 10^24 yoctoNEAR) at finalized block height 230000000 or later, on or before 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z.

elements.q: Do the exhibits show a finalized view_account result for example.near with amount at least 100000000000000000000000000 yoctoNEAR at a block height of 230000000 or higher and block time on or before 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z?

custom_definitions: Finality: only finality=final query results count; optimistic or non-final blocks never do.
Balance means the account's liquid amount field, excluding locked/staked balance, at the quoted block, pinned by block hash in the exhibit.
Two independent RPC providers must return the same block hash and amount at that height; a disagreement is a source conflict (VOID), not a majority.
Reorgs: NEAR has single-slot finality; for Ethereum-family chains require 64 blocks of depth.
Burden of proof is on YES: an unproven or ambiguous element resolves NO.
Early resolution: YES may be declared at the first qualifying event; NO only at/after the deadline.
Fallback: a blocked, rate-limited or unreachable source is COULDNT_CHECK (never NO); the recovery ladder and the listed fallback source apply, then VOID.

bettype.fetch: POST https://rpc.mainnet.near.org {method: query, request_type: view_account, block_id: <height>}
